card.name: Inside capitalized EMBRYO-FETAL warning
card.fires_on: The letter O at the end of EMBRY in all-caps EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY boxed warnings. It also fires on the V in capitalized AGGRAVATE.

modes.label: EMBRYO-FETAL heading
modes.description: The O completing EMBRY in the capitalized boxed warning heading EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.
modes.example: WARNING: DIARRHEA AND EMBRY<<O>>-FETAL TOXICITY Z

modes.label: Other capitalized words

modes.example: INE, WHICH MAY FURTHER AGGRA<<V>>ATE DEHYDRATION AND ELECTRO

card.plain: It fires on the letter that finishes the capitalized word EMBRYO in boxed warnings about embryo-fetal toxicity.
